## 0.0.32 本地候选草稿 / Local release candidate draft

本说明为待维护者审阅的本地候选草稿。目前已完成 Windows 候选构建、独立临时环境中的命令行检查，以及隔离安装、升级和静默卸载验证，尚未发布到 GitHub 或镜像。下列验证不代表所有平台、原生界面或模型已经完成验收。

This local candidate draft awaits maintainer review. Windows candidate builds, command-line checks in independent temporary environments, and isolated installation, upgrade, and silent uninstallation checks have completed. No release or mirror upload has been performed. These checks do not establish acceptance for every platform, native interface, or model.

## 主要变化 / Highlights

- 媒体任务由共享队列与持久记录管理，切换页面后仍可恢复状态和输出；结果页可浏览媒体、工具与 Agent 产物，包括失败或取消前已生成的部分结果。
  Media tasks retain their status and outputs across page changes. Results include media, tool, and Agent outputs, including usable files produced before failure or cancellation.
- 修复图片与视频任务参数传递，保留尺寸、分块、阈值等显式设置及有效的零值；不支持的参数不再展示，并在执行前校验。
  Image and video jobs preserve explicit dimensions, tiling, thresholds, and valid zero values. Unsupported controls are hidden and requests are validated before execution.
- 媒体工作流支持命名保存、加载、另存、更新与删除方案。加载方案保留本次素材和输出位置，多窗口修改冲突时保留当前草稿；能力选择遵循实际串行工作流支持范围。
  Media workflow plans can be named, saved, loaded, updated, and deleted. Loading preserves the current inputs and output location, concurrent edits retain the local draft, and capability choices follow the supported serial workflow combinations.
- 加强结果移除与编辑器引用保护、任务失败/取消后的收尾及重试反馈，并修复隔离数据目录相关问题。
  Result removal and editor references receive stronger protection, with corrected failure/cancellation cleanup, retry feedback, and isolated data directory handling.
- 更新应用图标；标题栏、启动与引导界面、关于页根据实际深浅主题切换对应图案，并保留标题栏动效和减少动态效果偏好。
  Updated application artwork follows the resolved light or dark theme across the title bar, startup, onboarding, and About view while retaining the title animation and reduced-motion preference.

## 候选验证范围 / Candidate validation scope

- 已完成针对上述修改的本地逻辑测试、前端构建与隔离浏览器组件检查；局部真实媒体推理验证只覆盖已记录的小型 CPU 用例，不代表所有模型或 GPU 后端通过。
- 已重新构建 Windows 0.0.32 原生 release 程序。本地候选产物为安装包 85.9 MiB、便携包 118.3 MiB、更新归档 98.7 MiB。
- 打包的 bootstrap 在独立临时目录中通过 `health`、`env_info` 和 `list_models` 检查，模型列表返回 326 条信息，未报错误。
- 使用新的独立测试 AppId，在未启动应用的条件下完成 0.0.31 安装 → 0.0.32 升级 → 静默卸载。升级和卸载后，4 项保留样本的 SHA 校验一致；应用 EXE 已删除，两个临时注册表键及本次临时验证目录已清理。
- 原生界面仅初步打开观察到新图标，未完成完整 UI 验收；后续候选验证限定为命令行。
- macOS 与 Linux：本次仅完成发布契约和隔离小样本检查，尚未完成原生平台候选包验收。

- Local logic tests, frontend builds, and isolated browser component checks cover the changed behavior. Recorded small CPU inference checks do not establish compatibility for every model or GPU backend.
- The Windows 0.0.32 native release application was rebuilt. Local candidate artifacts are an 85.9 MiB installer, a 118.3 MiB portable package, and a 98.7 MiB update archive.
- The packaged bootstrap passed `health`, `env_info`, and `list_models` checks in an independent temporary directory. The model list returned 326 entries without errors.
- A new independent test AppId completed 0.0.31 installation → 0.0.32 upgrade → silent uninstallation without launching the application. SHA checks matched for all four retained samples after both upgrade and uninstallation; the application EXE, two temporary registry keys, and this temporary verification directory were removed.
- The native interface was opened only for an initial observation of the new icon; full native UI acceptance remains incomplete. Subsequent candidate checks are limited to the command line.
- macOS and Linux have release-contract and isolated fixture checks only; native candidate package acceptance remains pending.
